reactions.desc: When reduced to 10 hp or less it feigns death in hopes of deceiving its attackers. A creature that sees it in this state can determine it is a ruse via DC 15 Wis (Medicine) check. Ruse lasts until astralsupial ends it (no action required) up to 8 hrs. 1st attack it makes within 1 round of ending ruse has advantage.

special_abilities.name: Apposable Thumbs
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on climb-related Str (Athletics).

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: [+]and Smell[/+] Advantage: hearing/smell Wis (Perception).

special_abilities.name: Blind Senses
special_abilities.desc: Can’t use its blindsight while deafened and unable to smell.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

special_abilities.name: Sonic Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: When it takes thunder damage it becomes deafened until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Dig In
reactions.desc: Has resistance to one melee weapon attack that would hit it. To do so the avestruzii must see the attacker and must not have moved during its previous turn.

reactions.name: Dazzling Glow
reactions.desc: When a creature the aziza can see targets it with melee attack its skin briefly glows brightly causing the attacker to have disadvantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
special_abilities.desc: Can communicate with frogs and toads as if they shared a language.

tob3_baleful-miasma.name: Baleful Miasma
tob3_baleful-miasma.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

reactions.name: Swift Advance
reactions.desc: If a creature in same space as miasma moves miasma can move up to its speed with the creature. This move doesn't provoke opportunity attacks but miasma must move in same spaces creature moved ending in creature's space or space nearest to it.

special_abilities.name: Air Form
special_abilities.desc: Can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. Can move through space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Asphyxiate
special_abilities.desc: If a creature that breathes air starts its turn in miasma’s space it must make DC 12 Con save or begin suffocating as its lungs fill with the poisonous air emitted by the miasma. Suffocation lasts until creature ends its turn in a space not occupied by baleful miasma or the baleful miasma dies. When the suffocation ends the creature is poisoned until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Hazesight
special_abilities.desc: Can see through areas obscured by fog smoke and steam with o penalty.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 10 min.

tob3_beach-weird.name: Beach Weird
tob3_beach-weird.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Invisible in Water
special_abilities.desc: Is invisible while fully immersed in water.

special_abilities.name: Swim in Sand
special_abilities.desc: Can burrow through sand at half its swim speed. It can’t make attacks while immersed in sand.

special_abilities.name: Tidepool Bound
special_abilities.desc: Dies if it moves more than 100' from the tide pools to which it is bound or if those tide pools remain waterless for more than 24 hrs.

tob3_bearfolk-thunderstomper.name: Bearfolk Thunderstomper
tob3_bearfolk-thunderstomper.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 15

bonus_actions.name: Frenzy
bonus_actions.desc: Triggers berserk frenzy for 1 min. It gains resistance to B/P/S damage from nonmagical weapons and has advantage on attacks. Attacks vs. frenzied bearfolk have advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Taunt
bonus_actions.desc:
2/día.
Jests at one creature it can see within 30' of it. If target can hear bearfolk target: DC 15 Cha save or disadvantage on ability checks attacks and saves until start of bearfolk's next turn.

special_abilities.name: Deceptive Steps
special_abilities.desc: While traveling can perform a stomping dance that mimics thundering footsteps of giants. Any creature within half mile that hears it but can’t see bearfolk: DC 15 Wis (Perception) or believe sound comes from Giants (or other Huge or larger creatures).

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

special_abilities.name: Compact
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy same space as one other clacker soldier.

tob3_beetle-clacker-swarm.name: Beetle, Clacker Swarm
tob3_beetle-clacker-swarm.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Constant Clacking
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm’s space takes 5 (1d10) thunder.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa and swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. Swarm can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Magically transforms into a Small or Med Humanoid or back into its true form. Its stats other than size are same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. If it dies it reverts to its true form.

special_abilities.name: Healing Lotuscraft
special_abilities.desc: (1/Day). Can spend 1 min crafting poultice that lasts 24 hrs. When a creature takes an action to apply poultice to a wound or skin of a creature target regains 18 (4d8) hp and is cured of any diseases or conditions affecting it.

bonus_actions.name: Saturated Expansion
bonus_actions.desc: While in contact with body of water it absorbs water that is a cube up to 10 ft. on a side and becomes saturated as water fills its body. While saturated increases in size along with anything it is wearing or carrying becoming Huge and has advantage on Str checks and Str saves. If it lacks room to become Huge it attains max size possible in space available. Ground exposed by the absorbed water becomes difficult terrain.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Aqueous Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: If it starts its turn in contact with body of water large enough to submerge at least half of its body it regains 10 hp if it has at least 1 hp.

special_abilities.name: Muck-Coated Slam (Saturated Only)
special_abilities.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 24 (3d12+5) bludgeoning damage and the target: DC 15 Dex save or its speed is reduced by 10 ft. as mud and muck coat it. A creature including target can take an action to clean off the mud and muck.

special_abilities.name: Multiattack
special_abilities.desc: Three Slams or two Muck-Coated Slam attacks.

special_abilities.name: Slam
special_abilities.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, 5 ft., one target, 14 (2d8+5) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Swamp Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks made to hide in marshland or swamp terrain.

special_abilities.name: Swamp Stalker
special_abilities.desc: Leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage when it moves through marshland or swamp terrain.

special_abilities.name: Water Jet (Saturated Only Recharge 4–6)
special_abilities.desc: Releases all absorbed water as a powerful jet in a 60' line that is 5 ft. wide. Each creature in that line: 40 (9d8) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 ft. away from it and knocked prone (DC 14 Dex half damage and isn’t pushed or knocked prone). After using Water Jet it is no longer saturated.

bonus_actions.name: Ice Slide
bonus_actions.desc: If the birgemon seal moves at least 10 ft. in a straight line while on snow or ice during its turn it can slide up to 40 feet.

special_abilities.name: Frozen to the Spot
special_abilities.desc: When on snow or ice the birgemon seal can’t be moved vs. its will.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Can hold its breath for 90 min.

tob3_black-patch.name: Black Patch
tob3_black-patch.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, prone

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Eldritch Luminance
special_abilities.desc: When a creature that can see the patch starts its turn within 90' of it patch can force it to make a DC 15 Wis save if ooze isn’t incapacitated and can see the creature. Fail: creature is mesmerized 1 min. Mesmerized creature over 5 ft. away from patch must move on its turn toward ooze by most direct route trying to get within 5 feet. It doesn’t avoid opportunity attacks but before moving into damaging terrain such as lava or a pit and whenever it takes damage from a source other than ooze target can re-save. Mesmerized target can also re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. If creature’s save succeeds or effect ends for it is immune to patch's Eldritch Luminance for next 24 hrs.

special_abilities.name: Flowing Form
special_abilities.desc: Can enter hostile creature’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1ft. wide with o squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Ooze Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn’t require sleep.

tob3_black-shuck.name: Black Shuck
tob3_black-shuck.languages: understands Abyssal and Common but can't speak
tob3_black-shuck.senses: darkvision 90 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 13
tob3_black-shuck.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing or slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

bonus_actions.name: Mist Stalker
bonus_actions.desc: In dim light fog or mist it takes the Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on attack rolls vs. any creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

special_abilities.name: Water Walker
special_abilities.desc: Can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless solid ground. This otherwise works like the water walk spell.

tob3_blaspheming-hand.name: Blaspheming Hand
tob3_blaspheming-hand.languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak
tob3_blaspheming-hand.damage_resistances: cold, fire, psychic; nonmagic B/P/S attacks not made w/silvered weapons

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Steadfast
special_abilities.desc: Can’t be charmed or frightened while at least one of its allies is within 30' of it.

special_abilities.name: Blur of Motion
special_abilities.desc: When it moves 30'+ on its turn ranged attack rolls vs. it have disadvantage until start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Freedom of Movement
special_abilities.desc: Ignores difficult terrain and magical effects can’t reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. Can spend 5 ft. of move to escape nonmagical restraints or being grappled.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Trampling Charge
special_abilities.desc: If it moves 30'+ straight toward a creature and then hits it with gore on the same turn target: DC 15 Str save or be knocked prone. If target is prone blestsessebe can make one hooves attack vs. it as a bonus action.

reactions.name: Host Defense
reactions.desc: When a creature damages an attached blood barnacle with anything other than fire creature hosting barnacle must make DC 12 Wis save or use its reaction to protect the barnacle. Barnacle takes half the damage dealt to it and host takes the other half.

special_abilities.name: Barnacle Shivers
special_abilities.desc: Characterized by inescapable cold and shiveringthat slowly pervades victim’s body this is a disease that infects creatures attacked by blood barnacles. Until disease is cured infected creature can’t regain hp except magically and its hp max decreases by 3 (1d6) for every 24 hrs that elapse. Reduction lasts until disease is cured. Creature dies if disease reduces its hp max to 0. A Humanoid or Beast slain by this disease rises 24 hrs later as a zombie. Zombie isn’t under barnacle’s control but it views barnacle as an ally.

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent location of creatures that aren’t Constructs or Undead and that don’t have all of their hp within 60' of it and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from normal barnacle.

tob3_blood-flurry.name: Blood Flurry
tob3_blood-flurry.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

special_abilities.name: Blood Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent the location of creatures that aren’t Undead or Constructs within 30' of it.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless indistinguishable from collection of snowflakes whether resting on the ground or carried by natural winds. It loses this trait if it has consumed blood in the last 24 hrs.

special_abilities.name: Rust Vulnerability
special_abilities.desc: The large amount of iron in its diet makes it susceptible to effects that harm ferrous metal such as the rust monster’s Antennae.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: Can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa and flurry can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny crystalline Aberration. Can't regain hp or gain temp hp.

special_abilities.name: Call of the Grave
special_abilities.desc: Attacks made within 60' of the bone collector score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

special_abilities.name: Death Sense
special_abilities.desc: Can pinpoint by scent location of Undead creatures and creatures that have been dead no longer than 1 week within 60' of it and can sense the general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of it.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

tob3_bone-lord.name: Bone Lord
tob3_bone-lord.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; nonmagic bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks

legendary_actions.name: Sovereign's Onslaught
legendary_actions.desc: Commands up to four friendly Undead it can see within 60' of it to move. Each target can use its reaction to immediately move up to its speed. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Sovereign's Reprisal
legendary_actions.desc: Commands one friendly Undead within 30' to attack. Target can make one weapon attack as reaction.

legendary_actions.name: Call Servants
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Uses Servants of Death.

special_abilities.name: Death-Infused Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals extra 2d8 necrotic (included below).

special_abilities.name: Fling
special_abilities.desc: One Med or smaller object held or creature grappled by bone lord is thrown up to 60' in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 ft. it was thrown. If target is thrown at another creature that creature: DC 19 Dex save or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: Choose to succeed failed save.

special_abilities.name: Master Tactician
special_abilities.desc: It and any friendly Undead within 60' of it have advantage on attack rolls vs. a creature if at least one of the Undead’s allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and ally isn’t incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Pattern of Death (Recharge 6)
special_abilities.desc: Necrotic energy ripples out from the bone lord. Each creature that isn’t a Construct or Undead within 30' of it: 54 (12d8) necrotic (DC 19 Con half). Each friendly Undead within 30' of the bone lord including the bone lord regains hp equal to half the single highest amount of necrotic dealt.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: As long as at least one of its bones remains a destroyed bone lord gathers a new body in 1d10 days regaining all its hp and becoming active again. New body appears within 5 ft. of the largest remaining bone from its body.

special_abilities.name: Servants of Death
special_abilities.desc: The bone lord magically calls 3d6 skeletons or zombies 2d4 ghouls or 2 wights. Called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds acting as allies of bone lord and obeying its spoken commands. The Undead remain for 1 hr until bone lord dies or until bone lord dismisses them as a bonus action. Bone lord can have any number of Undead under its control at one time provided combined total CR of the Undead is no higher than 8.

special_abilities.name: Tail
special_abilities.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, 15 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage + 9 (2d8) necrotic. Target: DC 19 Str save or be pushed up to 15 ft. away from bone lord.

special_abilities.name: Turning
special_abilities.desc: [+]Defiance[/+] It and any Undead within 60' of it: advantage on saves vs. effects that turn Undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: Doesn't require air food drink or sleep.

tob3_brain-coral.name: Brain Coral
tob3_brain-coral.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, prone

special_abilities.name: Colony Cluster
special_abilities.desc: Consists of Huge central spire and 3 Small clusters. Each cluster acts on coral’s turn and shares its move allowing spire and clusters to swim total of 120' on coral’s turn. Cluster can’t move more than 120' from spire. Cluster over 120' away from spire for over 24 hrs enters dormant state becoming new brain coral after 30 days. Brain coral and its clusters share hp and damage dealt to cluster or spire reduces shared total. If more than one section of coral is included in damaging spell or effect (ex: Dragon’s breath weapon or lightning bolt spell) coral makes one save and takes damage as if only one section was affected. When coral takes 15+ damage in one turn cluster is destroyed. At end of its turn if coral took damage on previous turn it can expel one new cluster from spire per 15 damage it took. Can’t have more than 5 clusters active at a time.

special_abilities.name: Water Breathing
special_abilities.desc: Can breathe only underwater.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Beasts
special_abilities.desc: Can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

special_abilities.name: Mounted Warrior
special_abilities.desc: While mounted the brownie’s mount can’t be charmed or frightened.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Beasts
special_abilities.desc: Can communicate with Beasts as if they shared a language.
